analyst.summary: Seshaasai Technologies makes payment cards, handles customer communications, and provides IoT tracking tags mainly for banks and financial institutions. After a soft FY26 (revenue down slightly on weaker bank card-issuance demand), the business has clearly recovered -- the most recent quarter showed revenue up over 21% and profit up nearly 64% year-on-year, helped by new multi-year contracts worth over Rs 700 crore. The company carries almost no debt and earns strong returns on capital, but a small number of bank clients account for the bulk of revenue, and the stock has already rallied sharply in recent months. We rate it a Hold: a genuinely good business, but one that is more cyclical and client-concentrated than it may appear, and the easy re-rating has likely already happened.
